name: USW-Enterprise-8-PoE
title: Switch Enterprise 8 PoE (Vintage)
summary: Compact L3 switch: 8x2.5GbE all PoE+ (120W) with 2x10G SFP+ uplinks.

extra.vintage: titled '(Vintage)' but still priced in store
extra.acl_limits: IPv4 ACL 12, MAC ACL 10 (much lower than rack models)

gotchas: Marked 'Vintage' — superseded by the Pro Max 16 PoE / Pro HD line; expect no new features.
120W for 8 PoE+ ports = 15W/port average; PoE+ only, no PoE++.
SFP+ uplinks need modules/DACs; no 10GbE RJ45.
Very small ACL tables (12 IPv4 / 10 MAC) vs 128 on rack siblings.
best_for: small office/desk multi-gig PoE for 2.5G APs with 10G fiber uplink
